title: Nominal sizes.
officialText:
For the purposes of this chapter, where dimensions of lumber are specified, they shall be deemed to be
nominal dimensions unless specifically designated as actual dimensions (see Section 2304.2).
SECTION BC 2302
DEFINITIONS
